aNEWRECORDBINDINGTHISLANEADDEDANDWHY.whyNotAWholeFilePin: The delivered guidance now makes six assertions drawn from that record, so the receipt must name it. But it is NOT added to committedLegalRecords, because that path records a whole-file sha256 and this record moved 33 times in the last 30 days against the packet-set manifest's 12. aDEFECTTHISLANECAUSEDANDUNDIDANDWILLNAME.what: A build that fails an assertion AFTER runFamily() calls fs.rmSync(OUT, recursive) leaves the family directory deleted. The NEXT successful build then finds no prior source-receipt.json to snapshot, so carryForwardIdentityRefresh() has no previous document, preserveIdentityRefresh() is fail-safe on a missing file, and the hand-written identityRefresh block is silently gone - with the build reporting success and all nine counters zero.
aDEFECTTHISLANECAUSEDANDUNDIDANDWILLNAME.howItWasFound: This lane hit it by deliberately breaking its own guards to prove they fire. Two of the three guard failures land after the wipe. The block was restored by git checkout -- of the family directory followed by one clean build, and its survival was then verified explicitly.
aDEFECTTHISLANECAUSEDANDUNDIDANDWILLNAME.whyItIsWORTHRECORDING: scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/identity-refresh.mjs was written precisely to stop a rebuild erasing that annotation, and it does stop a SUCCESSFUL rebuild. It does not stop a FAILED rebuild followed by a successful one, because the failure destroys the evidence the module reads. Seventeen families are recorded as resting on these annotations. Out of scope for this lane's grant; named so it is not lost.
